question:
Select the pair which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

YAB−FHI

KMN−RTU
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aa42ca8c755a5b02942417221f9eba1f557b87f7de9281acd39b3fc22fd0134.png] Logic followed here is: (Each letter in the first group) + 7 = (Corresponding letter in the second group). **For** **YAB : FHI →**
